scenarios.name: Inspect concrete finish and weathering choices

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software has a part document open

scenario_steps.name: a new concrete appearance is open in the Appearance Editor
I expand Finish Bumps and open its Type list
it offers Broom Straight, Broom Curved, Smooth, Polished and Stamped/Custom
Finish Bumps has no separate enable checkbox
I expand Weathering and open its Type list
it offers Automatic and Custom Image
Weathering has a separate enable checkbox
Tint is a separate optional section
